title: o4fix v0.1.3 candidate: release build check
intro: The RIGHT side is always the new release build of o4fix.exe (refinement on by default, edge-offset splice fix). For 0073 and 0060 the LEFT side is the research wp1c render you already reviewed: these should look identical (measured applied-correction difference under 0.7 deg in these windows). For 0021 the LEFT side is the shipped v0.1.2 repair, rendered with the identical Gyroflow project: refined bursts should look the same or calmer on the right; the powerloop bursts were not refined (over the 4 deg cap) so any difference there comes from the splice fix alone.
